title: Everything Narrows But the Sky

mood.label: Chokepoints tighten
mood.summary: Chokepoints tighten everywhere - Hormuz, Bab al-Mandeb, Mocha - while oil near $108 pushes thirty-year US yields to 2007 highs. The bright spots are small and far off: a Delhi summit, a twenty-fifth anniversary, a spacecraft finally reaching Mercury.

lines: A drone goes down at the mouth of the strait.
Two hulls take fire in the dark off Oman.
Mocha changed hands while we slept -
Oil at a hundred and eight,
every step the same size as the last.
Delhi lays a table for Putin and Xi.
New York reads the names a twenty-fifth time.
Something small and patient reaches Mercury -
out there the channel is still wide.
